approved_payload.content: A 57-year-old man was shot dead outside the gate of a voting station at Boikhutso, Bushbuckridge, at about 00:15 on Thursday 5 November, while a group waited for vote counting to finish after the local government elections, Mpumalanga police spokesperson Brig Donald Mdhluli said. Police say two unknown men opened fire on the group and fled. A family member took him to hospital, where he was declared dead on arrival. The motive was unknown and no arrests were reported; police had not established any link to the election results. The map point is approximate: the Bushbuckridge town point, not the voting station.
